name: Room Tour
tagline: A website you walk through as you scroll: the camera moves room to room, with materials, products and artworks to click.
youSay: /room-tour A walk-through for our new tropical house with a pool, sold before it's built
whatYouGet: A walk you scroll through: three or four real viewpoints of the place, each joined to the next by one continuous camera move through a doorway, across a room or out onto a terrace
Things to click on the way: material tags that open spec cards, facts and a booking card, products with prices, colours and a cart, or a gallery's exact artworks that lift off the wall
A title that reads first, captions that rise as the camera settles, a rail of stops and a map with a red rippling you-are-here marker
The whole page with its own look and words and an ending that asks for the next step, a headless check on desktop and phone, and a video of the walk, as a static site you can host anywhere
goodFit: Interior designers and architects, new homes sold before they're built, hotels, resorts and venues, furniture shops, galleries and showrooms
Pages where walking through the place is the reason to enquire, book or buy
notFor: Exact surveys of real buildings: the walk is generated, so a real place should be rebuilt from its own photographs
Pages that must be very light: each walk is around 15–20 MB of frames
youBring: The place, who it's for and what they should do at the end
Optional: the brand's name, colours and tone, product photos, or a gallery's real artwork images
needs: Skillsmart credits: about 500 for a three-stop page
Optional: OpenCV for Python, for labels that follow objects and exact artworks

generates.estimate: about 500 a page: 20 a picture, 11 a second of video, 2 a cut-out

network.purpose: sharp for the tools; playwright-core for the headless check (installed once)
